title: rosa omissa f. danica
intro: Rosa omissa f. danica, commonly known as Rosa damascena, is a species of rose plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. It is a fragrant, flowering plant native to Iran and has been used for centuries in traditional medicine and perfumery. The health benefits of Rosa omissa f. danica include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils such as geraniol and linalool, that exert anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects.
